what_works: Heritage page leads with a sepia archival photo of the founding family and stitches three generations into one continuous timeline — perfect compositional template for a 'our family started this in 1972' contractor story.
what_does_not_translate: Heavy archival photo treatment requires real old photos; if the contractor only has phone shots from last year, the sepia layer will feel fake.
type_observations: Serif display (Trajan-style) for the family name, neutral sans for body — the serif name treatment is the entire emotional payload.
